title: Audible Alerts - volume settings (set to 0 to disable)
Alert volume level (for alerts not settable below)
desc: Sets a volume level for all alerts not specifically listed below

title: Encoded material alert
desc: Issues an audible alert when you receive encoded materials

title: Hull damage alert
desc: Issues an audible alert when your hull integrity drops below 40% health

title: Interdiction alert
desc: Issues an audible alert when an interdiction attempt is detected

title: Mission Target alert
desc: Issues an audible alert when a mission target is detected

title: Odyssey material irrelevant alert
desc: Issues an audible alert when you collect an Odyssey material that is irrelevant for suit or weapon upgrades

title: Targeted System NOT KNOWN to EDSM
desc: Plays EDCoPilot.NotKnownToEDSM.mp3 if the system you are targeting is NOT KNOWN to EDSM

title: Targeted System KNOWN to EDSM
desc: Plays EDCoPilot.KnownToEDSM.mp3 if the system you are targeting is KNOWN to EDSM

title: Randomly trigger user custom sample
desc: If ON and you have put sound files in the sounds/User Samples subfolders for an event type, EDCoPilot will occasionally play one of the sounds when the event happens in game

title: User samples folder location
desc: Set this to a folder containing subfolders for each triggered event eg. c:\EDCoPilot\sounds\User samples

title: Play samples via Voice Attack command
desc: If ON then user samples will be triggered by VA command so they can be directed to a different audio device. Requires you to import the PlaySampleCommand-Profile.vap file and copy the 2 commands into your own custom profile, then edit the 'play sample specified in file' command to direct the Play event to your preferred Channel
